pairs: Congregata sunt ergo Philisthiim universa agmina in Aphec:
Then all the troops of the Philistines were gathered together at Aphek.
et Israël castrametatus est super fontem qui erat in Jezrahel.
above the spring which is in Jezreel.
Et satrapæ quidem Philisthiim incedebant in centuriis et millibus:
And indeed, the princes of the Philistines advanced by hundreds and by thousands;
David autem et viri ejus erant in novissimo agmine cum Achis.
but David and his men were in the rear with Achish.
And the leaders of the Philistines said to Achish,
“What do these Hebrews intend to do?”
Et ait Achis ad principes Philisthiim:
And Achish said to the leaders of the Philistines:
qui fuit servus Saul regis Israël,
who was the servant of Saul, the king of Israel,
et est apud me multis diebus,
and who has been with me for many days,
et non inveni in eo quidquam ex die qua transfugit ad me usque ad diem hanc?
and I have not found within him anything, from the day that he fled to me, even to this day?”
Irati sunt autem adversus eum principes Philisthiim,
Then the leaders of the Philistines became angry against him,
et sedeat in loco suo in quo constituisti eum,
and let him settle in his place,
et non descendat nobiscum in prælium,
But let him not descend with us to battle,
lest he become an adversary to us when we begin to fight.
quomodo enim aliter poterit placare dominum suum,
For in what other way will he be able to please his lord,
et David in decem millibus suis?
Vocavit ergo Achis David, et ait ei:
you are good and righteous in my sight,
et exitus tuus, et introitus tuus mecum est in castris:
even in your departure and your return with me in the military camp.
et non inveni in te quidquam mali ex die qua venisti ad me usque in diem hanc:
And I have not found anything evil in you, from the day that you came to me, even to this day.
But you are not pleasing to the princes.
et vade in pace, et non offendas oculos satraparum Philisthiim.
and go in peace, so that you do not offend the eyes of the princes of the Philistines.”
et quid invenisti in me servo tuo,
or what have you found in me, your servant,
a die qua fui in conspectu tuo usque in diem hanc,
from the day that I was in your sight to this day,
ut non veniam et pugnem contra inimicos domini mei regis?
so that I may not go out and fight against the enemies of my lord, the king?”
Scio quia bonus es tu in oculis meis,
“I know that you are good in my sight,
But the leaders of the Philistines have said:
‘He shall not go up with us to the battle.’
And so, rise up in the morning,
et servi domini tui qui venerunt tecum:
you and the servants of your lord who came with you.
And when you have risen up in the night,
as it begins to be light,
And so David rose up in the night,
so that they might set out in the morning.
And they returned to the land of the Philistines.
But the Philistines ascended to Jezreel.
